feedUrls.title: Feed or website URLs
feedUrls.description: RSS, Atom or JSON Feed URLs. You can also paste a normal website or blog URL: the Actor looks for the feed (link tags, then common paths such as /feed and /rss.xml).

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Max items per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Newest items first. 0 = everything in the feed (up to 1,000).

onlyNewItems.title: Only new items since the last run
onlyNewItems.description: For scheduled monitoring. Remembers which items each feed contained at the last run (in a named key-value store) and outputs only items that appeared since. The first run returns the newest items (up to the per-feed max). Unchanged feeds are skipped with conditional requests (ETag / Last-Modified).

stateKey.title: Monitor name
stateKey.description: Keeps separate 'already seen' lists for different schedules or tasks that read the same feeds.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Only items published after this date. Absolute (2026-10-01) or relative (24 hours, 7 days, 2 weeks). Items without a date are skipped when this is set.

includeKeywords.title: Include keywords
includeKeywords.description: Keep only items whose title, summary, content, author or categories contain at least one of these (case-insensitive).

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop items containing any of these (case-insensitive).

fetchFullText.title: Fetch full article text
fetchFullText.description: Open each item's link and extract the main article text as Markdown (robots.txt respected, no logins or paywalls). Charged separately, only when text is found.

includeContentHtml.title: Include content HTML from the feed
includeContentHtml.description: Add the feed's own full content (content:encoded / Atom content) as HTML. Makes items larger.

outputFeedFormat.title: Merged output feed
outputFeedFormat.description: Also save all returned items as one merged, filtered feed in the key-value store (record OUTPUT_FEED). Plug it into any feed reader, Slack or Zapier.

outputFeedTitle.title: Merged feed title
outputFeedTitle.description: Title of the merged output feed.

discoverFeeds.title: Discover feeds on web pages
discoverFeeds.description: If a URL is a normal web page, look for its RSS/Atom/JSON feed.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many feeds are fetched in parallel.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per request (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for each feed or page.
